notes.text:
**[PR #206931](https://starlightagilebi.visualstudio.com/AgBI/_git/FDE_Revenue_Bedrock/pullrequest/206931) — UI Shell, Tenant App Scaffolding, ModernWork App**
Author: Sri Voruganti · `users/srvoru/UIDev` → `main` · ~163 files, 8 commits

**What it delivers**
- **UI Shell** (`platform/src/app-platform`, ~50 files): React + TypeScript + Fluent UI single-page shell hosting feature modules; MSAL + Entra ID auth, top/left nav, LobAppHost + registry, theme & preference providers, shared UI components & libraries, env-driven runtime config, Vite + dev mocks.
- **Tenant app scaffolding** (`shared/dev-tools/scaffold-tenant-app`): generator (`npm run scaffold:tenant`) that stamps a new tenant LOB app from ModernWork, wires it into the workspace and shell `main.tsx`, runs `npm install`; shipped as a dev-tool and a Copilot skill.
- **ModernWork tenant app** (`tenants/modern-work`, ~28 files): reference LOB dashboard app with mock data and app-platform/data-platform structure (renamed from `tenant-a`).
- **Shared packages**: `shared/auth` (AuthProvider, RequireAuth, hooks, MSAL runtime, types) and `shared/contracts` (GraphQL schema + shared types / BFF contract).
- **Architecture & docs**: 4-layer architecture (shell → microfrontend modules → GraphQL BFF → Fabric/Power BI/SQL), 6 ADRs, monorepo workspace wiring.

**Out of scope (next tasks):** no API implementation, no infra/deployment scripts, no internal home dashboard yet.
